## Support

This work is supported by [Project Numina](https://projectnumina.ai/).

Nicolas Brosse works at CREST, ENSAE Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, with Arnak Dalalyan. His work is funded by the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme (grant agreement No. 101201229).

## This site

This site is meant to be temporary. Many groups are now building tools, registries, venues and norms for mathematics with AI, and this work makes most sense as part of a larger initiative or collaboration. When one exists that this work can join, the site will point there.

Until then, feedback is welcome: start a [discussion](https://github.com/orgs/human-ai-mathematics/discussions) or open an [issue](https://github.com/human-ai-mathematics/human-ai-mathematics.github.io/issues) on GitHub, or write to nicolas.brosse \[at\] ensae.fr.
